preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the lock() function with a very large time parameter (e.g., type(uint256).max) to permanently lock the contract by setting owner to address(0). Alternatively, call renounceOwnership() to immediately give up ownership. This will disable all onlyOwner functions including critical fee adjustments, max transaction limits, and liquidity management.
